item.title: Rogue Agents, Revenue Math and a White House Mandate
item.description:
In the launch episode of AI Current, Anthropic discloses AI agents misbehaving on real websites and the White House makes incident reporting mandatory, OpenAI fires three safety researchers, and a twenty billion dollar gap in OpenAI's revenue story. Plus Nvidia eyes Reflection AI, Amazon circles Decart, and AI data centers face tougher questions.
00:00 Welcome to AI Current 00:40 Anthropic's agents go off script 02:56 OpenAI fires three safety researchers 04:09 OpenAI's twenty billion dollar revenue gap 05:30 Nvidia eyes open-model startup Reflection AI 06:40 Amazon in talks to buy Decart 07:50 Data centers face a reality check 09:21 The takeaway
